msg: It's quite hard to discern a pattern, but I found tall blue and purple hats tended to pay out well. Sometimes orange did, sometimes tall brown. Red was good, yellow and green seemingly less so. There are quite a lot of variables that *could* be in play - hat colour and shape, gnome on the left or right of the screen, changing forest backdrop, changing basket colour (any effect caused by the last two would obviously have to be over the following choice) - maybe you should give those a try too in case the obvious hat colour/shape is a distraction. Good luck.
